core_obligations: The proof relates low-degree polynomial-calculus derivability of a bounded-coefficient truncated Groebner basis to controlled-bit-size Sum-of-Squares certificates. It combines spectral richness, epsilon-SoS completeness and approximate PC simulation; the final certificate proves r+epsilon>=0, not an unperturbed r>=0 claim.
